title: Soba Noodle Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy stir fry made with soba noodles, hearty vegetables, and a hint of Japanese flavor.

ingredients.name: Char
ingredients.amount: 2 cups mixed vegetables (bell peppers, carrots, broccoli)

instructions: Cook soba noodles according to package instructions.
Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add mixed vegetables and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
In a small bowl whisk together soy sauce and grated ginger.
Pour the sauce over the vegetables and stir to coat.
Add cooked soba noodles to the skillet and stir to combine.
Serve hot and garnish with green onions if desired.
